brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a service visit for a broken furnace.
facts: The furnace stopped heating last night.
The home address is 742 Evergreen Terrace.
The caller's name is John Doe.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, though they may not be able to quote a price until they see the problem

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, new installations on 2, billing on 3.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: IVR Menu
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Heating and Cooling. For service, press 1. For new installations, press 2. For billing, press 3.

script.label: Agent Greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling service scheduling. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

script.label: Ask Name and Address
script.text: I can certainly help you schedule a repair visit. May I have your full name and service address, please?

script.label: Ask Phone Number
script.text: Thank you. And what is the best callback phone number for the technician?

script.label: Ask Issue Description
script.text: Got it. Could you briefly describe what issue you are experiencing with your system?

script.label: Quote Price
script.text: Understood. The standard diagnostic and service visit fee is quoted at exactly 430 dollars.

script.label: Offer Window
script.text: We have an opening tomorrow with an arrival window between 8:00 AM and 12:00 PM. Does that work for you?

script.label: Confirm Booking
script.text: Perfect, I have you booked for tomorrow between 8:00 AM and 12:00 PM.

script.label: Ask Further Assistance
script.text: You will receive an automated text confirmation shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

script.label: Call Wrap-up
script.text: Thank you for choosing Apex Heating and Cooling. Have a great day!

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
